wish: someone should make a tool that checks whether two images are exactly the same
spec:
Decodes two images in the browser and compares every pixel, ignoring metadata, format and compression.
Pick or drop image A and image B; it says Identical or Different, counts differing pixels, shows where, and notes whether the files themselves are byte-identical.
It does not do fuzzy or perceptual matching, and never uploads anything.
notes: Pixel comparison after browser decoding with colour-space conversion off; EXIF orientation is applied by the decoder.
